ChildProfile.title: ChildProfile
ChildProfile.description: Represents a child's growth tracker profile including date of birth, Age 2 baseline height/weight, natural complexion, and optional Google Drive avatar photo reference.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent/guardian who owns this profile.

name.description: Display name or nickname of the child.

birthDate.description: Child's date of birth in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format used to calculate exact age automatically (or empty string if unset).

sex.description: Biological sex reference curve used for WHO height-for-age and weight-for-age percentile calculations.

ageTwoHeightCm.description: Child's baseline height at age 2 in centimeters (70 to 115 cm).

ageTwoWeightKg.description: Child's baseline weight at age 2 in kilograms (8 to 25 kg).

paletteId.description: Selected visual outfit theme for the growing character.

accessoryId.description: Selected head accessory for the growing character.

hairStyle.description: Selected hairstyle for the growing character.

skinTone.description: Natural skin complexion hex color (#RRGGBB) for the realistic growing avatar.

hairColor.description: Natural hair hex color (#RRGGBB) for the growing avatar.

avatarDriveFileId.description: Optional Google Drive file ID referencing the child's cropped avatar portrait stored in Google Drive (never raw image bytes in Firestore).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the child profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the child profile was last updated.

GrowthMeasurement.title: GrowthMeasurement
GrowthMeasurement.description: A recorded height and weight milestone for a specific child at a given age.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent/guardian who owns this measurement.

childId.description: ID of the parent ChildProfile document.

ageMonths.description: Age of the child in months at the time of measurement (0 to 216 months).

heightCm.description: Measured height in centimeters (45 to 210 cm).

weightKg.description: Measured weight in kilograms (2.5 to 120 kg).

recordedDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when the measurement was taken.

note.description: Optional short milestone note (up to 120 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the measurement record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the measurement record was last updated.

ChildPhoto.title: ChildPhoto
ChildPhoto.description: Lightweight metadata for every portrait or wall height photo taken for a child. Raw image bytes are stored locally in IndexedDB and optionally in Google Drive (never in Firestore).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent/guardian who owns this photo record.

childId.description: ID of the parent ChildProfile document.

kind.description: Whether the picture was taken in the Avatar Photo Studio or the Wall Height Guesstimator.

capturedDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when the photo was taken or saved.

ageMonths.description: Child's age in months at the time the photo was saved (0 to 216 months).

heightCm.description: Associated or estimated height in centimeters (0 if unset, up to 210 cm).

weightKg.description: Associated weight in kilograms (0 if unset, up to 120 kg).

caption.description: Short caption or source label for the photo (up to 120 characters).

driveFileId.description: Optional Google Drive file ID where the JPEG image is backed up (strictly blocks base64/data URLs).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo metadata record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo metadata record was last updated.

/children/{childId}.description: Stores child profiles owned by authenticated parents/guardians.

/children/{childId}/measurements/{measur.description: Stores height and weight milestones belonging to a specific child profile.

/children/{childId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Stores lightweight metadata and optional Google Drive file IDs for saved child portraits and wall height photos.
